text: Entry2123 removes browser shared-head allowances for disconnected message managers, missing message handlers and missing receiving ends. The author states these errors no longer occur and should be fixed in tests if they return. This is scoped accepted cleanup of broad allowances in this harness, not a claim that all expected rejections or directory allowances are forbidden. The generic import disappears while the mailnews utility alias remains. No test execution independently established error absence.
title: Remove obsolete directory-wide rejection allowances from extension browser tests
